title: [nightly/feature] Eclectic score on the course page: a "My Best" row on the scorecard
summary: The course scorecard gets a My Best row: the golfer's best score on each hole there, with OUT, IN and TOT adding up to their eclectic score. It answers "what's realistic for me here?" and supports club eclectic competitions. The server works it out from rounds already saved.
stillOpen: Couldn't open the PR: the run had no GitHub access. Written against frontend-refactor before the redesign merge, so it needs porting onto factory/library-feature.
